transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Um, I'm here because I've been losing a lot of weight lately and it's starting to worry my family. I'm just really struggling to eat more than a few bites of food at a time.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, and then try to get rid of it by vomiting, laxatives, or excessive exercise?
No, I definitely don't do that. I never eat large amounts of food, and I've never tried to throw up or use laxatives.
Have you been feeling sad, empty, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, over the past two weeks?
I haven't really been feeling sad or hopeless, to be honest. Most of my focus and worry has just been on my weight and my eating habits lately.
Do you have a strong fear of gaining weight or becoming fat, even though you've already lost a significant amount of weight?

Yes, I have an intense, overwhelming fear of gaining weight or becoming fat. Even though I've already lost weight, the thought of putting any of it back on makes me extremely anxious. I feel this constant need to keep my weight as low as possible.
Have you experienced any changes in your menstrual cycle, such as irregular periods or a cessation of menstruation, since you started losing weight?
I haven't really noticed any changes in my menstrual cycle, to be honest. It's not really something I've been tracking or focusing on lately.
Let me ask that another way: have you had a menstrual period in the past few months, or has your period stopped altogether since you started losing weight?
I'm really not sure. I haven't been paying close attention to my cycle recently, so I can't say for certain if it has stopped.
Can you try to think back to the last time you remember having a menstrual period, and we can go from there to understand if there have been any changes?
I honestly can't remember when my last period was. I haven't kept track of it at all, so I really couldn't tell you a specific date or even a month.
Can I get a nurse to come in and take your weight and height, so we can calculate your body mass index?

Oh, please, do we really have to do that? I am absolutely terrified of the scale, and the thought of anyone seeing my weight makes me feel extremely anxious. Is it absolutely necessary to weigh me today?

I understand your concern, but yes, it's necessary to get an accurate measurement of your weight and height to assess your overall health. Can you tell me more about what's making you so anxious about being weighed?

I'm terrified of seeing the number on the scale go up, even by a tiny fraction of a pound. The thought of gaining weight, or being told that I need to gain weight, is just deeply distressing and makes me panic.

It seems like we've covered all the necessary topics. I'm going to step out for a moment to review your information and discuss the next steps with our team. We'll be back in to discuss the diagnosis and treatment plan with you.
Okay, thank you, Doctor. I'll wait here for you to return with the team.
